name: metr_point_v0_tail_guard10
rationale: The two individual 10% local repairs each lowered both calibration metrics. Combining stronger 50% repairs overcorrected absolute error despite improving MSE. Keep each correction at its independently successful conservative strength and check whether both local rules coexist without that overcorrection. This is a fixed handwritten rule, no parameter sweep, gradients, optimizer, or test-derived coefficients.
